EmailTemplate.subject: finding new clients isn’t easy...
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Lead.FirstName},
I’m with EverQuote, and I’m reaching out because many advisors face some (if not all) of these challenges:
Finding new qualified life insurance clients is difficult You’re not growing your book as quickly as you wanted You’re not bringing in new business as consistently as you wanted But you don’t have the time to cold call 100 prospects everyday You’re spending money on marketing and not seeing a return
Do any of those challenges sound familiar? If so, I’d love to talk with you about how I can help. I’ll give you a call tomorrow afternoon or, if you’re interested, we can schedule a quick 15-minute call to further discuss your unique business needs.
Sincerely, {!User.FirstName}
{!User.Name} Account Executive (855) 543-3607 EverQuote, Inc. | 210 Broadway | Cambridge, MA 02139
